verdict.rationale: Aider documents a Python scripting API (Coder.create / coder.run) with static code snippets, so an API-reference axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable in-browser examples, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. Static scripting examples are adjacent documentation, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
